capabilities: chat within a note to reframe negative thoughts
summarize reframed thoughts into a table of affirmations
configure OpenAI, Deepseek, or local Ollama as the AI provider
edit the system prompt and preferred response language
run chat and summarize via ribbon, command palette, or slash commands
extras: Extensive disclaimer: not a replacement for therapy and not reviewed by licensed therapists. Warns that OpenAI/Deepseek providers send messages off-device and describes a 'fictional client' prompt to reduce personal identification. Includes Ollama troubleshooting (OLLAMA_ORIGINS/OLLAMA_HOST) and marks the preferred-language feature as Beta.
motivation: The author says they personally found ChatCBT useful for managing negative thoughts and positions it as an interactive worksheet, though it was built without domain expertise in psychology.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get guided, cognitive-behavioral-style feedback on journal entries; AI chat normally requires leaving the vault or a separate tool without CBT structure.

relations.evidence: use either a cloud-based AI service (OpenAI/Deepseek), or a 100% local
Deepseek is a cloud AI provider backed by a Chinese research team.
Ollama is a client that allows you to easily run powerful open source LLM models locally

summary: CBT-inspired AI journaling assistant that chats in a note to reframe negative thoughts and summarizes the reframed thoughts into a table.
